findings.failure_path: validate_finding_dispositions accepts disposition="source_refuted" for any finding regardless of severity, and validation explicitly proves binding rather than truth. An implementer who received a P0 finding on an unchanged candidate can emit status=passed, completion_gated=false, next_action=complete by writing one bounded prose sentence per occurrence — no reviewer is recalled and the emitted receipt does not carry the refuted severities or the evidence text, so a downstream consumer that accepts completion_basis=source_refuted_findings sees a green completion over an unresolved P0.
findings.smallest_fix: Record the refuted occurrences' severities (e.g. add "severity" to each entry of resolved_finding_occurrences) so a consuming gate can require additional authority before a P0/P1 source refutation closes a candidate.

findings.failure_path: The revised exhaustion rule replaces the previous hard stop with "another necessary bounded sequence" whose only limits — recording continuation_basis, cumulative rounds and old/new sequence links — live in a caller-owned task artifact that the stateless controller never reads or validates. Combined with the explicit instruction not to add the field to CLI arguments or runtime receipts, nothing mechanically bounds the total number of chains, so an agent can restart with fresh bindings indefinitely while each receipt still reports human_decision_required=true.
findings.smallest_fix: State in this section that the cumulative-sequence bound is unenforced by the controller and must be enforced by the consuming trusted platform, or name a concrete maximum number of restarted sequences per task.

concern_results.conclusion: Packet MCP wiring, TOML override encoding (including dotted/spaced/quoted inherited server names), search offset/line arithmetic, and the disposition/occurrence binding in validate_finding_dispositions are internally consistent and match their tests. Chain arithmetic (mode order, contiguous autonomous_review_index, prior_review_result_sha256 accumulation, distinct challenge focuses) is checked per round, so a forged or reordered history is rejected.

The new reviewer tool surface is genuinely bounded: pathless read/search only, hash rechecked on every call, shell_tool disabled by effective capability with a fail-closed capability probe, inherited MCP servers disabled per-invocation without mutating user config, and the parser rejects any mcp_tool_call outside code_review_packet. The material residual risk is governance, not a code bypass: complete mode can now turn open P0 findings into status=passed on self-written prose evidence that the validator explicitly does not verify.

Provider/capability failures still die inconclusive with cascade_eligible; packet binding drift, forged result bytes, argument-schema violations and incomplete tool lifecycles all map to inconclusive rather than pass, and pending_packet_calls blocks a turn that never completed a started call. Error-then-retry paths are handled.

Tests are appropriate and would fail with the risky behavior present: the wrapper suite drives a real stdio packet server and kills a tampered-bytes case, and the completion suite covers missing/duplicated/reordered occurrences, stale and changed candidates, inconclusive receipts, forged history and non-source_refuted dispositions. Gap: no test asserts a severity floor, so a P0-closing refutation is not distinguished from a P2 one.

Inline (packetless) Codex parsing still passes without tools, --packet-sha256 is optional, and complete mode without --finding-dispositions-file keeps its previous strict passed/empty-findings behavior. The relaxed codex stub --help match and the added CONTROLLER_OWNED_FIELDS entries are additive.

Doc and controller changes land together in this partition; the new completion basis is opt-in via a new flag, so rollback is dropping the flag path. No persistent host state is written — packet files live under RUN_ROOT and user Codex config is untouched.

completion_basis, finding_dispositions_sha256 and resolved_finding_occurrences are emitted, so a consumer can see that findings were locally refuted; raw receipts are asserted unchanged. However the receipt does not carry the refuted findings' severities or the evidence text, so an operator must re-open the manifest and every prior receipt to judge what was closed.

Its containment (unchanged candidate, complete original chain, exactly-once occurrence coverage, no budget refresh, no merge authority) is enforced mechanically.
